20:00 │ EN VIVO AHORA: James Talarico: A CNN & Jubilee Town Hall
As the consequential midterm elections near, Texas Senate Candidate Rep. James Talarico takes questions from a live audience of Texas voters - Democrats, Republicans and Independents - who intend to vote in November. Erin Burnett moderates.

21:30 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: The Source: CNN Talarico Town Hall Postshow
Live coverage and analysis of the CNN & Jubilee Town Hall. Kaitlan Collins anchors.
